article.title: Los Angeles faces Golden State, looks to break 4-game skid
article.linkText: Los Angeles faces Golden State, looks to break 4-game skid
article.story: Los Angeles Clippers (1-4, 14th in the Western Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (3-3, 10th in the Western Conference) San Francisco; Sunday, 8:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles heads into the matchup against Golden State as losers of four games in a row. Golden State finished 37-45 overall, 24-28 in Western Conference play and 22-19 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Warriors averaged 9.7 steals, 4.2 blocks and 15.0 turnovers per game last season. Los Angeles went 42-40 overall, 10-6 in Pacific Division games and 19-22 on the road a season ago. The Clippers averaged 9.0 steals, 4.9 blocks and 13.5 turnovers per game last season. INJURIES: Warriors: Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee). Clippers: Max Strus: out (foot), Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
